'''Trenar Stillijan''' was the husband of [[Rees Haslip]] and father of [[Keriin Haslip|Keriin]]. The adventurous type, he left Garos IV and joined the army. Stillijan was killed on a battlefield far from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
